entities.summary: Harry Arthur Saintsbury, usually called H. A. Saintsbury, was an English actor and playwright. A leading man, he became well known for his stage interpretation of Sherlock Holmes, was an early mentor of Charlie Chaplin, and is considered an authority on the work of Sir Henry Irving.
